items.lang|tensura_boss_structure|item.tensura: Right-click to summon the Slime King on the surface
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.ki: The swamp seems to be a habitat for slimes. Kill 5 slimes, then come back and report.
A pack of slimes has been sighted in the wild. Accept the commission to receive a target of 4 to 8 slimes, then return after the subjugation.
Hound dogs driven by summoning magic are threatening nearby routes. Slay 5 hound dogs, then return to submit the commission.
Barghest howls unsettle nearby settlements, and their black flames are dangerous. Slay 5 barghests, then return to submit the commission.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.co: Magic ore shards split from magicule-rich veins. The guild needs samples for appraisal. Bring back 5 magic ore shards to submit.
Medium quality magic crystals store steadier magicules. The guild is restocking research materials. Bring back 10 crystals to submit.
Palm saplings are useful for restoring coastal groves and expanding guild-managed plantations. Bring back 3 palm saplings to submit.
Blade tiger meat is a valuable field ration once cooked. The guild needs fresh samples for provisioning. Bring back 5 raw blade tiger meat.
Giant bat meat is often gathered from cave hunts. Bring back 5 raw giant bat meat for the guild stores.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.cr: High potions are reliable recovery supplies for dangerous commissions. Craft and submit 3 high potions.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.co: Sissie fins are treated as fish materials and are useful for food preparation. Bring back 2 sissie fins.
C-rank monster leather is used for basic gear, saddles, and field equipment. Bring back 20 pieces.
B-rank monster leather is tougher and suited for sturdier equipment. Bring back 10 pieces.
Hipokute flowers are important recovery materials and refining ingredients. Bring back 4 flowers.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.fi: The guild is restocking basic magic manuals. Find 1 Grimoire (D) from wizard tower ruins or old magical collections and bring it back.
A Grimoire (C) can hold steadier spell records for novice study. Find 1 Grimoire (C) and bring it back.
B-rank grimoires are uncommon and often kept by magic researchers. Find 1 Grimoire (B) and bring it to the guild for appraisal.
A Grimoire (A) records higher-tier magical systems. The guild needs a sample for its archives. Find 1 and submit it.
A Grimoire (Special A) is said to be treasured only by veteran magic users. If you find one, bring it back for safekeeping.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.co: A heavy core holds unusually dense power and is useful for high-grade guild appraisal work. Obtain 1 heavy core and submit it.
A marionette heart is a rare magical material with dangerous life-altering properties. Obtain 1 marionette heart and submit it.
A darkness core emits unstable dark power. The guild needs a sample to confirm its uses. Obtain 1 darkness core and submit it.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.ki: An Elemental Colossus carries pressure far beyond ordinary monsters. Only prepared adventurers should approach it. Slay 1 Elemental Colossus, then return to submit the commission.
The guild has detected an abnormally swollen Supermassive Slime roaming nearby. Travel to the marked coordinates, draw it out, and subjugate it before it runs wild.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.pa: Squad commission. The squad must have more than 1 member. Clear 20 Giant Ants within 150 blocks of a Giant Ant Nest. The 30 silver coin reward is split by the squad, and each member gains 25 adventure EXP.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.cl: Black Spiders have blocked a route near their nest. Travel to a Black Spider Nest, clear 20 Black Spiders within 150 blocks of it, then return to submit the commission.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.in: The guild needs a report on an abandoned wizard tower. Travel to the marked coordinates, find and investigate any wizard tower, then return to submit the commission.
items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.ki: Giant Cod are fighting over the coastal fishing grounds. Subjugate 3 Giant Cod, then return to the guild to submit the commission.
